# LoadRunner Java Vuser Import Coverage

<!-- Generated by `go generate ./pkg/convert/enterprisearchive` (cmd/webcoverage -set java-surfaces). Do not edit by hand. -->

This matrix covers the Java Vuser importer surfaces outside the closed `lrapi.lr` utility API. Recorded Java-over-HTTP targets native HTTP requests, not the inert `java_http` object codec. Arbitrary/custom Java remains governed sidecar opt-in or named review; unsupported behavior is never fabricated.

## Surface Disposition

| ID | Area | Construct | Status | Execution | Review | Fields | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `java-lr-api` | LoadRunner Utility API | lrapi.lr.* | `supported` | `classified` | no | transaction, parameter, message, runtime, timer | The closed lr API is fully classified by java_lr_function_matrix; executable effects map to native actions or config, non-executable effects are named review dispositions. |
| `java-web-http` | HTTP | web.* / HttpURLConnection / HttpClient / Apache HttpClient | `supported` | `executable` | no | url, method, headers, body, transactions | Recognized Java-over-HTTP idioms are converted through the same executable HTTP path used by C web_* imports; generic Java object-over-HTTP remains review-only. |
| `java-jms` | Messaging | javax.jms / jakarta.jms | `supported` | `executable` | no | provider, destination, body, properties, transactions | JMS provider and queue/topic targeting are inferred from source evidence, with broker credentials redacted into secret references. |
| `java-jdbc` | Database | java.sql DriverManager/Connection/PreparedStatement | `supported` | `executable` | no | sql, query, exec, commit, rollback | Statically recoverable JDBC statements are delegated to the database importer and emitted as db_query/db_exec/transaction actions. |
| `java-soap` | SOAP | JAX-WS / SOAPMessage / Axis / CXF | `partial` | `scoped_executable` | yes | endpoint, envelope | Recoverable static endpoint/envelope calls become native HTTP SOAP requests; dynamic SOAP clients remain named review items. |
| `java-no-runtime-surfaces` | Review | RMI, EJB, CORBA, SAP GUI Java, Jacada, Oracle NCA, Tuxedo | `review_only` | `not_executable` | yes |  | No-runtime Java middleware surfaces receive deterministic named review dispositions instead of generic fallthrough. |
| `java-custom-code` | Custom Java | helpers, third-party clients, arbitrary Java | `review_only` | `external_runner_opt_in` | yes |  | Arbitrary Java is preserved for review by default; governed java_vuser sidecar replay requires explicit operator opt-in. |

| `java-jdbc-connect` | JDBC | DriverManager.getConnection | `partial` | `review_required` | yes | dsn | Connection literals are redacted to {{secret.database_dsn}}; operators must bind the real DSN. |

| `java-jdbc-transactions` | JDBC | setAutoCommit(false) / commit / rollback | `supported` | `executable` | no | db_begin, db_commit, db_rollback | Transaction controls map to native database transaction actions. |
